newsitem.title: USA: Kellogg Co Q3 net declines.
newsitem.headline: Kellogg Co Q3 net declines.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTE: Q3 1996 results include after-tax charges of $21.3 million, or $0.10 a share. Excluding charges, Q3 operating net was $0.85 a share, which company said was consistent with projection made on September 4.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Nine-month results include non-recurring charges of $44.3 million after-tax, or $0.21 a share vs charges of $33.0 million after tax, or $0.15 a share.
Q3 1996 charges include a provision of $15.0 million for the potential settlement of certain litigation matters.

The balance of the 1996 and all of the 1995 charges related primarily to ongoing productivity and operational streamlining initiatives in the U.S., Europe and other international locations. The charges are comprised principally of expenditures for employee severance, training and relocation, management consulting, and production redeployment.
Excluding charges, nine-month operating earnings were $2.29 a share vs $2.71.
